title: SPAR-Hate: An Auditor-Guided Multi-Agent Framework for Bilingual Hate Speech Parsing
abstract: arXiv:2608.22018v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Hate speech detection has recently shifted from coarse-grained classification to structured parsing, where systems must jointly identify hateful targets, arguments, and target-level labels. However, existing studies primarily emphasize benchmark evaluation while paying less attention to the cultural, linguistic, and social-group challenges involved in structured hate speech parsing. To address these challenges, we propose SPAR-Hate, an auditor-guided multi-agent framework for bilingual hate speech parsing. The framework first decomposes documents into clause-level decision units and then generates evidence-grounded judgments from three complementary perspectives: Victim, Moderator, and Cultural Bystander. An evidence-constrained arbitration process resolves conflicts among role-specific predictions and aggregates them into structured sample-level outputs. translated_title: SPAR-Hate：一种审计引导的多智能体框架用于双语仇恨言论解析
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.22018v1 公告类型：新 摘要：仇恨言论检测近期已从粗粒度分类转向结构化解析，系统需联合识别仇恨目标、论据及目标级标签。然而，现有研究主要侧重于基准评估，而对结构化仇恨言论解析中涉及的文化、语言和社会群体挑战关注不足。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了SPAR-Hate，一种审计引导的多智能体框架，用于双语仇恨言论解析。该框架首先将文档分解为从句级决策单元，然后从三个互补视角——受害者、版主和文化旁观者——生成基于证据的判定。一个证据约束的仲裁过程解决角色特定预测之间的冲突，并将其聚合为结构化的样本级输出。在STATE-ToxiCN和TBO基准上的实验表明，SPAR-Hate始终...
tldr: 本文提出SPAR-Hate，一种审计引导的多智能体框架，通过分解文档为从句单元并从受害者、版主和文化旁观者三个视角生成证据判定，实现双语仇恨言论的结构化解析，在多个基准上表现稳定。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes SPAR-Hate, an auditor-guided multi-agent framework that decomposes documents into clause units and generates evidence-grounded judgments from victim, moderator, and cultural bystander perspectives for bilingual hate speech parsing, achieving consistent performance on multiple benchmarks.
